content: Alendronate is supplied in tablet form under the brand name FOSAMAX, available in various dosages: 5 mg, 10 mg, 35 mg, 40 mg, and 70 mg. Below are the detailed descriptions of each dosage form and their respective packaging: 1. FOSAMAX 5 mg Tablets These tablets are white, round, and uncoated. They feature an outline of a bone image on one side and the code MRK 925 on the other. Packaging: NDC 0006-0925-31: Unit-of-use bottles containing 30 tablets. NDC 0006-0925-58: Unit-of-use bottles containing 100 tablets. 2. FOSAMAX 10 mg Tablets These tablets are white, oval, and wax-polished. They have the code MRK on one side and 936 on the other. Packaging: NDC 0006-0936-31: Unit-of-use bottles containing 30 tablets. NDC 0006-0936-58: Unit-of-use bottles containing 100 tablets. NDC 0006-0936-28: Unit dose packages containing 100 tablets. NDC 0006-0936-82: Bottles containing 1,000 tablets. NDC 0006-0936-72: Cartons containing 25 UNIBLISTER cards, each with 31 tablets. 3. FOSAMAX 35 mg Tablets These tablets are white, oval, and uncoated. They have the code 77 on one side and a bone image on the other. Packaging: NDC 0006-0077-44: Unit-of-use blister packages containing 4 tablets. NDC 0006-0077-21: Unit dose packages containing 20 tablets. 4. FOSAMAX 40 mg Tablets These tablets are white, triangular-shaped, and uncoated. They feature the code MRK 212 on one side and FOSAMAX on the other. Packaging: NDC 0006-0212-31: Unit-of-use bottles containing 30 tablets. 5. FOSAMAX 70 mg Tablets These tablets are white, oval, and uncoated. They have the code 31 on one side and an outline of a bone image on the other. Packaging: NDC 0006-0031-44: Unit-of-use blister packages containing 4 tablets. NDC 0006-0031-21: Unit dose packages containing 20 tablets. Storage Instructions: Store the tablets in a well-closed container at room temperature, between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F). This information is adapted from the FDA Package Insert.
